project.name: Sharma Associates Website
project.description: Public marketing website for Sharma & Associates, a Chartered Accountancy firm in Mumbai, built to convert visitors into consultation bookings
project.tagline: A trustworthy, modern CA firm for growing businesses in Mumbai
project.core_principle: Secrets live only in environment variables and all form input is validated on the server
project.v1_scope_boundary: Inside V1: four service pages, about page, and a consultation form that emails the firm. Deferred: client portal, login, blog or CMS, payments, live calendar slots, multi-language

tech_stack.why: SSG and SSR for SEO, server actions for the form, native Vercel fit
Fast mobile-first styling with consistent design tokens
Simple transactional email API with no SMTP to manage
Schema validation at the server boundary
Unit tests for logic and one E2E test for the booking flow

project.architecture_overview: Next.js App Router site on Vercel. The consultation form submits to a server action that validates input with Zod, applies honeypot and per-IP rate limiting, then sends one email to the firm and one confirmation to the visitor through Resend. No database.
project.success_metric_v1: Deployed on a real domain, a test booking reaches the firm's inbox, and Lighthouse scores 90 or higher on mobile

brainstorm.problem: Sharma & Associates has no public web presence that convinces small business owners to trust the firm and book a consultation
brainstorm.user: A small business owner or startup founder in Mumbai, browsing on a phone, looking for GST, accounting, audit or company setup help
brainstorm.core_loop: Visitor lands on the site, reads the services, submits the consultation form, and the firm receives the request and confirms by reply
brainstorm.what_this_is_not: Not a client portal, no login, no blog or CMS, no payments, no live calendar booking, not multi-language

key_features_v1: Home page with a hero, a book-a-consultation call to action, services summary, why-us and placeholder testimonials
Services pages for tax and ITR, GST and compliance, audit and assurance, and accounting and business setup
About page covering the firm and team
Contact and book page with the consultation form, address, phone and WhatsApp link
Server-side validated booking action that emails the firm and confirms to the visitor
SEO basics: per-page metadata, sitemap, robots and LocalBusiness structured data
key_constraints: Secrets such as the Resend API key and the firm email address live only in environment variables
All form input is validated on the server regardless of client checks
Mobile-first layout that meets WCAG 2.2 AA
No database and no authentication in V1
Content is placeholder until the firm supplies real logo, team, address and contact details

decision_log.reason: Small marketing site with one integration and fewer than fifteen tasks

decision_log.decision: Booking via form and email instead of a calendar embed or custom system
decision_log.reason: Simplest option that proves the core loop, calendar embed deferred to V2
Simple API and good fit with Vercel, no SMTP to manage
